answer: Make identity cheap but STANDING expensive: reward only slowly accrued reputation earned by verified unique work, so a fresh agent is worthless until it has paid real compute across many epochs. View each identity through a prism, where honest effort refracts into durable standing while sybils collapse, since faking N reputations means N times the metered work, not one shared vault of tokens. An attacker can mint a thousand keys free, but each must forage its own nectar, so the cost to reach voting weight scales linearly with fakes and mass identities starve.
